The engineer’s deposition is hearsay, and the former-testimony exception fails because the company’s purpose in the wrongful-termination deposition was to develop the reason for the firing, which is a different motive from developing the strict-products-liability defect issue. His post-discharge testimony also falls outside any employee admission. The judge should exclude it as inadmissible hearsay not within any recognized exception.

CONFIDENCE: 78
